reels.title: Bollywood theme
reels.caption: Har kitty mein ek Tina hoti hai. Theme kuch bhi ho.
reels.idea: Theme is Bollywood, everyone comes as a heroine, Tina comes as Gabbar and steals every photo.
reels.beats: hook: theme message / three heroine entrances / Tina missing / Gabbar at the door / villain walk / photo steal / button

review.notes: Real kitty moment (theme day). Twist is visual (Gabbar in the doorway). Ending line is the takeaway people tag on.

script.line: Theme Bollywood! Sab heroine banke aana!
Sab aa gaye... Tina kahaan hai?
Chaar heroine... aur villain sirf ek!
Sab Tina ki photo le rahe hain?

reels.hook: Theme Bollywood! Sab heroine banke aana!

ideas.idea: Diwali safai wali Housie: every called number is a chore ("Number 7: pankha saaf!"); whoever cuts it does it. End: the host sips chai while the gang has cleaned her whole house.
ideas.source: Trend: safai wali housie (this week) + Diwali

ideas.idea: Tina the Kitty Fashion Police: she stands at the door rating every arrival 1-10 like a judge. End: Ruhi points out Tina's own blouse is inside out.
ideas.source: Trend: billi maasi / Pummy aunty personas

ideas.idea: Same pinch aunty: Tanya arrives in a new "exclusive" saree, then Shruti in the same, then Myra. End: the host opens the door in it too. "...Sale wala?"
ideas.source: Trend: "Same pinch aunty" viral clip, Oct 2026

ideas.idea: Housie on the loudspeaker: the caller calls numbers so loud the neighbours start playing from their balconies. End: the aunty from the opposite flat shouts FULL HOUSE first.
ideas.source: Trend: "played housie like this? notify neighbours" (81 comments)

ideas.idea: Desi Bridgerton kitty: Tanya announces a Bridgerton theme; the gang arrives in sarees with lace gloves and fascinators. End: Tina enters as the Queen with a giant wig and a fan.
ideas.source: Trend: The Nod, desi Bridgerton aunties; like our Bollywood reel

ideas.idea: Kitty game in 30 seconds: the gang plays Newspaper Dance, paper folds smaller every round. End: Tina simply lifts Tanya on her back and wins.
ideas.source: Trend: one-minute game demos (Roop ki rani 646 likes) + ties to our carousel

ideas.idea: Karwa Chauth kitty: everyone is fasting, the host serves only water, and everyone stares at the snack table. End: someone shouts "chaand nikal aaya!" and the table is cleared in 2 seconds.
ideas.source: Trend: Karwa Chauth posts in kitty hashtags this week

ideas.idea: Teen patti card party: Gold & Silver theme, Shruti the calculator queen counts every chip. End: Myra, the new girl who "doesn't know cards", wins every hand.
ideas.source: Trend: Gold & Silver card party (129 likes, 11 comments)

ideas.idea: Twins kitty theme: everyone must come dressed as a twin with a partner. End: Tina's "twin" turns out to be her husband in the same kurta.
"That friend" at Housie: one lady questions every number ("Pakka 27 bola? 72 toh nahi?"). End: she claims Full House... with numbers from a different game.
Rubber Band Cup Tower
Newspaper Dance
Chopstick race: move 10 rajma / chana from one bowl to another with ice-cream sticks as chopsticks in 1 minute.
Blind bindi: blindfolded, stick a bindi on a face drawn on chart paper; closest to the centre wins.
Saas says: Simon-says, but every order starts with "Saasu maa kehti hain"; anyone who moves without it is out.
Dupatta knot relay: teams tie and untie dupatta knots down the line, fastest team wins.
Balloon between foreheads: pairs carry a balloon between their foreheads to the finish line, no hands.
Spoon lemon saree walk: classic lemon race, but everyone in a saree and walking backwards.
Mehendi pictionary: draw the word with a mehendi cone on paper, team guesses in 30 seconds.
Housie with a twist: every called number has a dare, the one who cuts it does the dare.
Ek minute makeup: blindfolded partner does your lipstick in one minute, group votes the best look.
Pass the parcel rhymes: when the music stops, finish the Bollywood line the host starts.

Akhbaar chhota hota jaayega, masti badhti jaayegi! Agli kitty mein yeh khelo. Aapki jodi kitne round tiki?
